description: Official restrictions for future operation manifests.

globalRestrictions.rule: Never change Constitution during ordinary operations.
Never edit runtime directly unless a future approved publishing or runtime operation explicitly allows it.
Never change Core during article or calculator creation unless the operation is explicitly update-law or update-table.
Never change Strategy during Publishing unless a separate strategy operation was approved first.
Validation operations are read-only by default.
Migration operations require rollback readiness before execution.
Publishing requires testing pass, validation pass, rollback readiness and manual approval.
Manifests must avoid large physical file lists and should reference logical components.
Nucleus operations in Phase 4.1 must not create real nuclei, public guides or pages.
Nucleus operations must not change public pages, runtime, SEO, URLs, sitemap, public catalogs or pending public working tree files.

notes: Restrictions are declarative and do not enforce behavior by themselves.
Future engines must treat these restrictions as gates before file changes.
